milestones.outcome: Accept the current eligible exact file material with a discoverable keyboard shortcut that never revokes acceptance or consumes text editing input.
exit_criteria: AC1: An eligible current file can be Accepted with a keyboard shortcut, without opening the file action menu.
AC2: The shortcut is discoverable in the existing action/menu or shortcut presentation and does not collide with existing bindings or steal normal text editing input.

AC3: No-current-file, excluded/unavailable, stale authority and other ineligible states follow the existing Accept action policy. Repeated presses must not inadvertently revoke acceptance unless the established shortcut contract explicitly calls for a toggle.
AC4: Verify actual key delivery through the composed window, matching current file/epoch acceptance and focused shortcut collision/eligibility cases.
All acceptance criteria have direct evidence, documentation and explicit commits; any explicitly required human, native or independent criterion stays pending until supplied.
milestones.boundary: BPR-1515 only; preserve BPR-1507 canonical action and all unrelated work. Return quiescent handoff to coordinator.
